empty.title: No groups
empty.description: Create a group for a holiday, your home or a dinner: add the people taking part and record the expenses. The data stays on this device. If someone sent you an exported group, open it with “Import”.

noArchived.description: When a group is over you can archive it from its settings: it will show up here.

export.title: Export
export.description: Save a file with the whole group: expenses, payments, members and changes. Use it as a backup, or to move the group to another device or person, who opens it with “Import” in the list of groups. Importing it several times creates no duplicates: only what is new is added.
